name: FTI Markings
description: Documents labelled as federal tax information (the IRC 6103 citation or the words Federal Tax Information).

name: FTI Return Data
description: A tax form or transcript name with a Social Security or taxpayer identification number within 500 characters.
expression: ((D:FTI-Tax-Forms > 0) AND ((D:FTI-Social Security Numbers (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:FTI-Tax Identification Number (US) - Prox 500 > 0)))
